title: Controlled flip

tutorial.text: CNOT flips the target only when the control is 1. q0 is already 1. Make |11⟩.
tutorial.action: Select q0 and tap CNOT (control on q0, target on q1).

hints: The dot is the control, ⊕ is the target.
why: CNOT is a conditional X. Because q0 is 1, q1 gets flipped.
